summary: Normalize an immutable existing-code snapshot, pull request, or externally produced change into a reviewable candidate without implementing it.

inputs.name: request
inputs.description: Quality objective, target locator, candidate provenance and scope.

inputs.name: project-context
inputs.description: Current project boundaries and accessible source/verification paths.

inputs.name: specification
inputs.description: Known acceptance criteria and constraints, if available.

completion_checks: Source type, immutable candidate identity, and available base/diff are established from observed evidence.
The inspected surfaces and known behavior claims are distinguished from unknown requirements.
No candidate source, tracker, review, or deployment is mutated.
failure_modes: The named candidate or base cannot be resolved to inspectable content: blocked.
A mutable ref or uncertain external source cannot establish a fixed subject: inconclusive.
Evidence contradicts the requested target identity: failed.
